beats.text: She stands dark against the seam and does not step out of it.
The ash ring lies between you. Hers is the print that is the wrong shape.
"Thirty-one," she says, without turning round. "So you are the thirty-second."
beats.speaker: Dhara

beats.text: She holds a stick of charcoal the length of her hand and waits to see what you do with it.
